goal: Review documentation accuracy and test coverage for the uncommitted local manifest telemetry change.
background: Review target: uncommitted working-tree changes (git diff HEAD).
Changed files (tracked, modified), paths relative to bakeoff/ context root:
Primary surface for this lens: README.md, docs/cli-reference.md, internal/manifest/manifest_test.go, internal/commands/doctorcmd/doctor_test.go.

Companion lenses run separately: correctness (code defects in manifest.go) and telemetry-schema (manifest contract). This lens focuses ONLY on doc accuracy and test quality/coverage — not production code design.

facet.focus: Confirm docs describe the changed behavior accurately and tests cover it meaningfully.
include: doc accuracy: do README and docs/cli-reference.md describe the new manifest telemetry behavior correctly and match the code changes
doc completeness: are user-visible new fields, flags, or behaviors documented
doc consistency: terminology, field names, and severity vocabulary used uniformly between docs and code
test coverage: are new manifest behaviors covered by manifest_test.go cases (happy path, empty input, multi-input, ordering, edge values)
test quality: are assertions specific (exact field/value checks) rather than incidental, are subtests named meaningfully
test independence: do new tests depend on undocumented ordering or shared state
missing negative tests: invalid inputs, conflicting severities, malformed entries
doctor_test.go change: does the test continue to assert what the docs/README claim about doctor output
exclude: production code design or correctness critique (covered by correctness lens)
telemetry schema/contract critique (covered by telemetry-schema lens)
style preferences without project convention evidence
